xep.header:
Bookmarks hierarchy This specification defines a way to organise bookmarks into directories and to order them. &LEGALNOTICE; xxxx ProtoXEP Standards Track Standards Council
XMPP Core XEP-0060 XEP-0402
NOT_YET_ASSIGNED &nicoco; &edhelas;
0.0.1 2026-10-17 nc
First draft.

section1.p: This specification provides a way to organise conversations into directories and to order them. It can be used as a private, user-specific organisation of chats, or as the server-provided organisation of a given &xep0503; node.

section2.p: Bookmark items that are part of the same node SHOULD have a hierarchy &xep0402; bookmark extension.

The hierarchy element MUST have a weight attribute whose value is a decimal number. Bookmarks are sorted by ascending weight. Using decimal numbers makes it possible to re-order a single item without modifying the other ones.

The hierarchy element MAY also have a directory attribute, which defines the name of the directory in which the bookmark is grouped, and a directory-weight attribute, which sorts the directories relative to each other.
section2.example: <iq type='result' to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony' id='retrieve1'> <pubsub xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/pubsub'> <items node='urn:xmpp:bookmarks:1'> <item id='theplay@conference.shakespeare.lit'> <conference xmlns='urn:xmpp:bookmarks:1' name='The Play's the Thing' autojoin='true'> <nick>JC</nick> <extensions> <hierarchy xmlns='urn:xmpp:bookmarks-hierarchy:0' weight='5.0' directory='General Rooms' directory-weight='2.1'/> </extensions> </conference> </item> </items> </pubsub> </iq>

section1.p: It is possible to use this specification for ordering without organising bookmarks into directories. In this case, the directory and directory-weight attributes are omitted and only weights matter.
In the presence of directories, bookmarks are first grouped by directory, the directories are ordered by directory-weight, and the bookmarks within each directory are then ordered by weight.
Bookmarks that have no directory attribute are not part of any directory. They MUST be displayed before all the directories, ordered by weight.
Directories whose bookmarks have no directory-weight attribute MUST be displayed after all the directories that have one.

To maintain coherence, if several bookmarks have the same directory but different directory-weight values, the entity MUST use the lowest directory-weight value to order the directories. It SHOULD also update the other bookmark items of that directory so that they all carry this value.
To avoid transient inconsistencies, deleting a directory MUST be preceded by removing the directory and directory-weight attributes from all the bookmarks that refer to it.
This document introduces no new security considerations.
This document requires no interaction with &IANA;.
The ®ISTRAR; shall include 'urn:xmpp:bookmarks-hierarchy:0' in its registry of protocol namespaces.

section1.code:
<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?> <xs:schema xmlns:xs='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema' targetNamespace='urn:xmpp:bookmarks-hierarchy:0' xmlns='urn:xmpp:bookmarks-hierarchy:0' elementFormDefault='qualified'>
<!-- Extension carried by a bookmark item. --> <xs:element name='hierarchy'> <xs:complexType> <xs:attribute name='weight' type='xs:decimal' use='required'/> <xs:attribute name='directory' type='xs:string' use='optional'/> <xs:attribute name='directory-weight' type='xs:decimal' use='optional'/> </xs:complexType> </xs:element> </xs:schema>
